review.status: Reviewed selection integrated into the app through Scripts/IconPack/pack.json.
policy: Reuse recognizable base marks from Simple Icons or Material Icon Theme, choosing the clearer silhouette at 16 pt.
Use Apple SF Symbols for generic file concepts and document/folder enclosures.
Preserve the author-supplied Markdown and four config shield compositions as drawn.
Monochrome is the proposed default; the rendering sheet also checks hierarchical, palette and multicolor.
limitations: Brand artwork has one outline reused across weights; conversion does not create optically adjusted SF Symbol weights.
All 535 Material references in the integrated registry have a reviewed symbol; generic types intentionally share native symbols.
Enclosed logos lose detail at sidebar size; use standalone base marks for ordinary source files.
